先更新旧攻略里常见的两件事: Update two common pieces of old advice
公园现行页面明确写明公众喂动物已经停止，旧版手册里“可以带生菜或芹菜”的说明不再: The current park page explicitly says public animal feeding has been discontinued. Older brochures inviting visitors to bring lettuce or celery no longer apply. Watch how animals move, rest, and communicate rather than reaching through fences or feeding them.
2026 年 5–12 月，Tilden 有降低火险的植被清理工程，部分道路和步: Tilden has vegetation work to reduce fire risk from May through December 2026, with intermittent road and trail closures. A September 15 update also lists the upper 0.43 miles of Laurel Canyon Trail as closed due to storm damage, with no reopening date. Check current notices rather than following an old loop regardless of conditions.
前 30–40 分钟：在 Little Farm 的开放区域看动物，选一种动物观: First 30–40 minutes: watch animals in open Little Farm areas and spend three minutes with one species. Follow closure signs and skip sections rather than trying to cover every enclosure.
接着 30–40 分钟：教育中心开放时进去看展，找出一个与外面看到的植物或水有关: Next 30–40 minutes: visit the education center if open and find a clue related to plants or water seen outside. Current published hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 10 am–4:30 pm.
最后 20–40 分钟：按现场地图在开放正式步道短走，感觉泥泞、坡度或疲劳不合适: Final 20–40 minutes: take a short walk on an open official trail using the on-site map. Turn back if mud, slopes, or fatigue make it unsuitable. Leave time for restrooms and returning to parking.
带什么，怎么到: What to bring and how to arrive
自然区页面列出停车不收费，但园内其他景点和游乐项目各有规则。这里不允许带狗进入: The Nature Area page lists no parking fee, but other attractions and rides have their own rules. Dogs are not allowed in Tilden Nature Area, so choose another suitable area if bringing one. Pack water, snacks, and a layer; keep strollers on suitable surfaces. Attractions are spread out, so confirm transit reaches the nature area and has a workable return service.
